programs.summary: LFPL describes English-language learning materials, multilingual collections, conversation activities, Transparent Language access and citizenship study resources.
programs.cost_note: Library resource access depends on card status and location; some non-residents may pay for a card.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Availability of a particular language, class, conversation group or branch event; valid LFPL card for remote access to certain online language tools.
programs.important_to_know: Library resources do not establish eligibility for immigration benefits or substitute for legal counsel. Class dates and spaces are separate from continuing digital resources.
programs.first_step: Read LFPL's Immigrant Services information and current language programs before planning attendance or remote study.

programs.title: LFPL Accessibility and Homebound Outreach Services
programs.summary: LFPL describes bookmobile and mail-delivery options for qualifying homebound patrons, accessible materials, assistive services and sign-language interpretation for some library events.
programs.cost_note: Eligibility and individual services should be verified with LFPL; no guaranteed delivery, device or interpretation is implied.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Homebound or group residence program criteria, location and scheduled-route capacity; for interpreters, LFPL states at least one week's advance request.
programs.important_to_know: Services vary by branch and request. LFPL also describes hearing-loop-equipped meeting rooms at selected libraries; the Main Library is currently closed for renovations.
programs.first_step: Visit LFPL's Accessibility Services page and ask about bookmobile, Books To You or a specific accommodation.

programs.title: LFPL Meeting Rooms — Public Community Programs
programs.summary: LFPL makes selected meeting rooms available by reservation for qualifying educational, cultural, civic and charitable activities when not needed for library programs.
programs.cost_note: LFPL restricts fundraising, sales, solicitation, admission charges and other financial gain in meeting rooms; review any applicable facility terms.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Meeting must be free and open to the public; LFPL generally requires requests at least three days in advance, no more than three months ahead; branch-specific capacity and rules apply.
programs.important_to_know: Not an administrative office, private meeting space, fundraising venue or implied LFPL endorsement. A requested reservation is not confirmed until the library approves it.
programs.first_step: Review the LFPL Services meeting-room rules and submit the official reservation form for an appropriate public-use event.

programs.title: LFPL Candid — Foundation and Grant Research
programs.summary: LFPL lists Candid (formerly Foundation Center) research information on foundations, donors and grants as part of its research databases.
programs.cost_note: Library research access is offered under LFPL rules; costs associated with external grant applications or professional services are separate.
programs.eligibility_to_check: This resource is explicitly restricted to in-library use; confirm which branch location offers it and current database access.
programs.important_to_know: Being listed in a grant database does not mean a grant is open, available to an individual, or appropriate for a particular organization. LFPL explicitly states Candid is only available inside the library.
programs.first_step: Visit the LFPL Research Databases page, locate Candid, and confirm an available branch and access method.

programs.title: LFPL Exam Proctoring — Scheduled Learning Support
programs.summary: LFPL provides exam proctoring subject to staff and equipment availability, with reservation requirements and limitations on testing conditions.
programs.cost_note: LFPL says it does not charge proctoring fees; students remain responsible for fees their institutions or exam providers charge.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Reserve at least five days before each exam; institution rules, ID requirements, scheduling, technical requirements and staff authorization.
programs.important_to_know: No walk-in proctoring; the library does not provide constant observation or private testing rooms, and cannot guarantee testing platform compatibility.
programs.first_step: Read LFPL's Exam Proctoring Policy under Services, then submit the official reservation request in advance.
